plain: A government body that tests advanced AI models and advises on their risks. Several have since been renamed.
eli5: The government's own team of testers who check the robots before and after they go on sale.
technical: A state-backed technical body for evaluating frontier models and advancing safety science, first set up by the UK and US after the 2023 Bletchley summit and linked in an international network; several have since changed name or remit.
